[EVENT] User is thinking of packing snacks and energy-boosting foods for the road trip.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended snacks such as nuts, dried fruits, jerky, energy bars, fresh fruits, and energy-boosting foods like coffee, granola balls, sandwiches, trail mix, and protein-rich snacks.
